_**User**_

這是我跟Codex聊的內容
```
目前ansible管理的CLI/app 是不是不會自動更新？跑過一次裝完就一直在舊版？ 這方面有什麼comment嗎？

---

**現況**

大致上是，你的理解沒錯: 目前這套 **不是自動更新器**，比較像「宣告式安裝 + 缺什麼補什麼」。

- `chezmoi apply` 不會每次都重跑 ansible。ansible phase 是 [`run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl`](/Users/daviddwlee84/.local/share/chezmoi/run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl:1)，只有 role/default 檔內容變了才會觸發；Brewfile 也是類似邏輯，在 [`run_onchange_after_30_brew_bundle.sh.tmpl`](/Users/daviddwlee84/.local/share/chezmoi/run_onchange_after_30_brew_bundle.sh.tmpl:1)。
- 就算 ansible 有重跑，多數 task 也只是 `state: present`，意思是「確保已安裝」，不是「升到最新版」。例如 [`dot_ansible/roles/base/tasks/main.yml`](/Users/daviddwlee84/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_ansible/roles/base/tasks/main.yml:4) 跟 [`dot_ansible/roles/devtools/tasks/main.yml`](/Users/daviddwlee84/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_ansible/roles/devtools/tasks/main.yml:15)。
- Brewfile 路徑更明確: 它直接跑 `brew bundle --no-upgrade`，所以 brew bundle 管的 app/cli 不會自動升版，看 [`run_onchange_after_30_brew_bundle.sh.tmpl`](/Users/daviddwlee84/.local/share/chezmoi/run_onchange_after_30_brew_bundle.sh.tmpl:126)。
- `uv tool` / `cargo install` 這些很多都用了 `creates:`，本質上是 install-once。例子: [`python_uv_tools/tasks/main.yml`](/Users/daviddwlee84/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_ansible/roles/python_uv_tools/tasks/main.yml:5)、[`rust_cargo_tools/tasks/main.yml`](/Users/daviddwlee84/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_ansible/roles/rust_cargo_tools/tasks/main.yml:18)。
- npm 類也大多是 `state: present` 或「只裝缺的」，不是 upgrade 流程。例子: [`js_cli_tools/tasks/main.yml`](/Users/daviddwlee84/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_ansible/roles/js_cli_tools/tasks/main.yml:73)、[`bitwarden/tasks/main.yml`](/Users/daviddwlee84/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_ansible/roles/bitwarden/tasks/main.yml:78)。
- 少數例外有升級傾向。macOS 的 Neovim 是 `state: latest`，看 [`neovim/tasks/main.yml`](/Users/daviddwlee84/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_ansible/roles/neovim/tasks/main.yml:19)。Homebrew 本身也會 `update_homebrew: true`，但那是更新 brew metadata，不是全面升 formula，看 [`homebrew/tasks/main.yml`](/Users/daviddwlee84/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_ansible/roles/homebrew/tasks/main.yml:25)。
- `chezmoiexternal` 是另一條線，這個會每週 refresh upstream clone，不靠 ansible。看 [`.chezmoiexternal.toml.tmpl`](/Users/daviddwlee84/.local/share/chezmoi/.chezmoiexternal.toml.tmpl:7)。

**Comment**

我覺得這個設計對 dotfiles repo 是合理的，因為 `chezmoi apply` 最怕的是順手把整台機器升到一堆新版本，然後引入不可預期 breakage。現在的策略偏保守、可重現。

但缺點也很明顯: 「安裝」跟「更新」語義目前有點混。repo 裡同時有 `present`、`latest`、`creates`、missing-only 幾種模式，所以使用者不太容易預期哪些工具會前進、哪些會卡在初裝版本。像 README 寫 mise `ensures latest versions`，如果解讀成「之後會持續跟上最新版」，其實偏樂觀了，看 [`README.md`](/Users/daviddwlee84/.local/share/chezmoi/README.md:198)。

我會建議把它拆成兩條路:

- `chezmoi apply` / ansible default: 維持現在這種保守 install-only 行為。
- 另外做一個明確的 upgrade 入口，例如 `just upgrade-tools` 或一個 ansible tag，專門跑 `brew upgrade`、拿掉 `brew bundle --no-upgrade`、`mise upgrade`、`uv tool upgrade --all`、`dotnet tool update --global` 等。

這樣會比「每次 apply 順便升級全部」乾淨很多。如果你要，我可以直接幫你把這個 repo 補成一套 `just upgrade-tools` / `just update-all` 的明確升級流。
```

Then I'll structure the just targets to give them granular control: `just upgrade-all` for everything, `just upgrade-brew` for just Homebrew, `just upgrade-lang` for specific language tools, and so on.

  "overview": "新增一條明確的 upgrade 路徑:&#96;scripts/upgrade_tools.sh&#96; 負責所有升級邏輯(Homebrew / Brewfile greedy / mise / uv / npm globals / cargo / dotnet / gem / curl-installer 工具 / LazyVim / TPM / pre-commit / tldr / chezmoi 本體),justfile 薄 wrapper 提供 &#96;just upgrade-all&#96; 與分類 recipe。&#96;chezmoi apply&#96; 的保守 install-only 行為維持不變。",
  "plan": "\n## Design principles\n\n- **Install path (&#96;chezmoi apply&#96; / ansible) stays conservative** — role &#96;state:&#96; 全部不改,&#96;creates:&#96; 也不動。\n- **Upgrade path is a separate, explicit shell script** — 不經過 ansible,避免「改了 role 又順便裝新東西」語意混亂。\n- **Sub-commands composable** — &#96;just upgrade-all&#96; 只是把分類 recipe 串起來;每一類都能單獨跑。\n- **Best-effort, 不中斷** — 一類升級失敗不影響下一類,最後列出失敗摘要(參考 [&#96;run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl&#96;](run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl) 裡的 &#96;allowPartialFailure&#96; 模式)。\n- **Reuse 既有基礎建設** — 共用 [&#96;scripts/lib/sudo_shared.sh&#96;](scripts/lib/sudo_shared.sh)(Linux apt / cask pkg 會用到)、共用既有的 &#96;info/success/warn/error&#96; 配色。\n\n## Main artifact: &#96;scripts/upgrade_tools.sh&#96;\n\n新檔,一般 bash 腳本,不是 chezmoi template(放 &#96;scripts/&#96;,已被 [&#96;.chezmoiignore.tmpl&#96;](.chezmoiignore.tmpl) 排除不部署)。\n\n### CLI surface\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nscripts/upgrade_tools.sh                    # = all\nscripts/upgrade_tools.sh all                # 跑所有預設類別\nscripts/upgrade_tools.sh brew               # Homebrew formulas/casks + Brewfile (greedy)\nscripts/upgrade_tools.sh mise               # mise self-update + mise upgrade\nscripts/upgrade_tools.sh uv                 # uv self update + uv tool upgrade --all\nscripts/upgrade_tools.sh npm                # npm update -g (+mise-exec fallback)\nscripts/upgrade_tools.sh cargo              # cargo-update -a (若有),否則 re-cargo install\nscripts/upgrade_tools.sh dotnet             # dotnet tool update --global 每個\nscripts/upgrade_tools.sh gem                # gem update 每個\nscripts/upgrade_tools.sh agents             # curl|bash installer 重跑:Claude Code / OpenCode / Cursor CLI / Ollama / llmfit / RTK\nscripts/upgrade_tools.sh plugins            # LazyVim / TPM / pre-commit autoupdate / tldr cache\nscripts/upgrade_tools.sh externals          # chezmoi apply --refresh-externals + chezmoi upgrade\nscripts/upgrade_tools.sh --dry-run \u003cscope\u003e  # 只印,不執行\nscripts/upgrade_tools.sh --only brew,uv     # 只跑指定類別\nscripts/upgrade_tools.sh --skip agents      # 跑 all 但跳過指定\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Per-category behavior\n\n| Category | Commands |\n|---|---|\n| &#96;brew&#96; | &#96;brew update&#96; → &#96;brew upgrade&#96; → &#96;brew upgrade --cask --greedy&#96; → &#96;brew bundle --file=~/.config/homebrew/Brewfile&#96;(拿掉 &#96;--no-upgrade&#96;)→ 對應的 &#96;Brewfile.darwin&#96; / &#96;Brewfile.linux&#96; → &#96;brew cleanup&#96;。macOS 呼叫 &#96;sudo_session_init \"brew\"&#96; + &#96;sudo_session_warm_cache&#96;(cask pkg 會用 &#96;sudo /usr/sbin/installer&#96;)。 |\n| &#96;mise&#96; | &#96;mise self-update&#96; → &#96;mise upgrade&#96;(升級已裝工具到 config 允許的最新)。 |\n| &#96;uv&#96; | &#96;uv self update&#96; → &#96;uv tool upgrade --all&#96;。 |\n| &#96;npm&#96; | 偵測 &#96;npm&#96; 在 PATH 否則 &#96;mise exec -- npm&#96;(沿用 [&#96;js_cli_tools&#96;](dot_ansible/roles/js_cli_tools/tasks/main.yml) 的偵測邏輯)→ &#96;npm -g update&#96;。 |\n| &#96;cargo&#96; | 檢查 &#96;cargo-install-update&#96;(套件名 &#96;cargo-update&#96;),沒裝就 &#96;cargo install cargo-update&#96; → &#96;cargo install-update -a&#96;。 |\n| &#96;dotnet&#96; | 讀取 [&#96;dot_ansible/roles/dotnet_tools/defaults/main.yml&#96;](dot_ansible/roles/dotnet_tools/defaults/main.yml) 的 &#96;dotnet_tools&#96; 列表 → 每個 &#96;dotnet tool update --global \u003cname\u003e&#96;。 |\n| &#96;gem&#96; | 若 mise ruby shim 存在則 &#96;gem update&#96;。 |\n| &#96;agents&#96; | &#96;ls -1 \"${HOME}/.claude/local/bin/claude\"&#96; 等偵測存在才升,重跑既有 installer:Claude Code &#96;curl https://claude.ai/install.sh&#96; / OpenCode &#96;curl https://opencode.ai/install&#96; / Cursor &#96;curl https://cursor.com/install&#96; / Ollama(Linux 有 &#96;ollama --version&#96; 才重跑)/ llmfit / RTK。列表跟 [&#96;coding_agents&#96;](dot_ansible/roles/coding_agents/tasks/main.yml) 一致。 |\n| &#96;plugins&#96; | &#96;nvim --headless \"+Lazy! sync\" +qa&#96; → &#96;~/.tmux/plugins/tpm/bin/update_plugins all&#96; → &#96;pre-commit autoupdate&#96;(repo 根)→ &#96;tldr --update&#96;(有裝才做)→ &#96;gh extension upgrade --all&#96;(有 gh 才做)。 |\n| &#96;externals&#96; | &#96;chezmoi upgrade&#96;(升 chezmoi 自己)→ &#96;chezmoi apply --refresh-externals&#96;。 |\n\n預設 &#96;all&#96; = &#96;externals → brew → mise → uv → npm → cargo → dotnet → gem → agents → plugins&#96;(跑順序很重要:先把 package manager 自己升上去,再升工具;externals 在最前面是因為 &#96;chezmoi upgrade&#96; 可能會換 chezmoi binary)。\n\n### Orchestration\n\n- 每一類用 &#96;run_category \"name\" category_fn&#96; 包起來,fn 內 &#96;set +e&#96; 記錄每步 rc;類別層級失敗 append 到 &#96;FAILED[]&#96;。\n- 結尾印:\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n  ────── Upgrade Summary ──────\n  [SUCCESS] brew, mise, uv, npm, cargo, dotnet, plugins\n  [FAILED]  agents (ollama installer rc=1 — 見上面 log)\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n- &#96;--dry-run&#96; 走 &#96;printf \"+ %s\\n\" \"$cmd\"&#96; 而不真的 exec。\n- macOS / Linux 的 Homebrew PATH 自動偵測,沿用 [&#96;run_onchange_after_30_brew_bundle.sh.tmpl&#96;](run_onchange_after_30_brew_bundle.sh.tmpl) 的 snippet。\n\n## justfile additions\n\n新增在 [&#96;justfile&#96;](justfile) 現有 &#96;# Setup Utilities&#96; 後,新增一個 section:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;makefile\n# ============================================================================\n# Upgrades (explicit, opt-in — &#96;chezmoi apply&#96; stays conservative)\n# ============================================================================\n\nupgrade-all:\n    ./scripts/upgrade_tools.sh all\n\nupgrade-brew:\n    ./scripts/upgrade_tools.sh brew\n\nupgrade-mise:\n    ./scripts/upgrade_tools.sh mise\n\nupgrade-uv:\n    ./scripts/upgrade_tools.sh uv\n\nupgrade-npm:\n    ./scripts/upgrade_tools.sh npm\n\nupgrade-cargo:\n    ./scripts/upgrade_tools.sh cargo\n\nupgrade-dotnet:\n    ./scripts/upgrade_tools.sh dotnet\n\nupgrade-gem:\n    ./scripts/upgrade_tools.sh gem\n\nupgrade-agents:\n    ./scripts/upgrade_tools.sh agents\n\nupgrade-plugins:\n    ./scripts/upgrade_tools.sh plugins\n\nupgrade-externals:\n    ./scripts/upgrade_tools.sh externals\n\nupgrade-dry-run:\n    ./scripts/upgrade_tools.sh --dry-run all\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Docs\n\n- 在 [&#96;AGENTS.md&#96;](AGENTS.md) 新增一段 &#96;## Upgrades&#96; section(放在 &#96;## Upstream Clones via .chezmoiexternal.toml.tmpl&#96; 後面),內容:install vs upgrade 的語意分離、&#96;just upgrade-*&#96; 的 matrix、&#96;chezmoi apply&#96; 為什麼故意不升。\n- [&#96;README.md&#96;](README.md) 加一小段 \"Keeping tools up-to-date\" 指向 &#96;just upgrade-all&#96;,順便修正目前 \"mise &#96;ensures latest versions&#96;\" 的說法。\n\n## 刻意不做的\n\n- 不改任何 ansible role 的 &#96;state:&#96; / &#96;creates:&#96;(保留 &#96;chezmoi apply&#96; 保守語意,Codex 的原始 comment 裡已解釋原因)。\n- 不動 &#96;brew bundle --no-upgrade&#96;(那是 &#96;chezmoi apply&#96; 觸發的 hook,必須保守);升級改由 upgrade script 另外呼叫一次不帶 &#96;--no-upgrade&#96;。\n- 不包 &#96;apt upgrade&#96; / 系統層升級 — 你沒勾這項;使用者要就手動 &#96;sudo apt upgrade&#96;。\n- 不包 LiteLLM/Ollama 以外的 Python/local service 重啟;只升 binary,不碰 daemon。\n\n## Flow diagram\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    user[\"&#96;just upgrade-all&#96;\"] --\u003e script[\"scripts/upgrade_tools.sh all\"]\n    script --\u003e externals[\"externals: chezmoi upgrade + refresh-externals\"]\n    externals --\u003e brew[\"brew: update + upgrade + cask --greedy + bundle\"]\n    brew --\u003e mise[\"mise: self-update + upgrade\"]\n    mise --\u003e uv[\"uv: self update + tool upgrade --all\"]\n    uv --\u003e npm[\"npm: -g update (or via mise exec)\"]\n    npm --\u003e cargo[\"cargo: install-update -a\"]\n    cargo --\u003e dotnet[\"dotnet: tool update --global each\"]\n    dotnet --\u003e gem[\"gem: gem update\"]\n    gem --\u003e agents[\"agents: re-run install.sh for each\"]\n    agents --\u003e plugins[\"plugins: Lazy sync + TPM + pre-commit + tldr\"]\n    plugins --\u003e summary[\"Summary: OK / FAILED\"]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Implementation order\n\n1. 先寫 &#96;scripts/upgrade_tools.sh&#96; 的骨架(argparse、run_category、summary、sudo helper inclusion via source)。\n2. 一次填一個 category,手動在本機跑過 &#96;--dry-run&#96; 再去掉 dry-run 驗證。\n3. 加 justfile recipes。\n4. 寫 AGENTS.md / README.md 段落。\n5. (可選)加一個 &#96;just upgrade-dry-run&#96; 到 &#96;check-all&#96; 流裡? — 我傾向不加,因為 &#96;upgrade&#96; 不是 CI 概念。\n",

```
    upgrade-agents          # curl|bash installers: Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Ollama, llmfit, RTK
    upgrade-all             # Upgrade everything: externals, brew, mise, uv, npm, cargo, dotnet, gem, agents, plugins
    upgrade-brew            # Homebrew formulas + casks (--greedy) + Brewfile (no --no-upgrade) + cleanup
    upgrade-cargo           # cargo install-update -a (bootstraps cargo-update crate if missing)
    upgrade-dotnet          # &#96;dotnet tool update --global &lt;name&gt;&#96; per tool in dotnet_tools defaults
    upgrade-dry-run         # Preview what &#96;just upgrade-all&#96; would do, without running anything
    upgrade-externals       # chezmoi upgrade + chezmoi apply --refresh-externals (oh-my-zsh, TPM, etc.)
    upgrade-gem             # rubygems + installed gems (via mise ruby shim)
    upgrade-mise            # mise self-update + &#96;mise upgrade&#96; (runtimes: node, rust, ruby, dotnet, bun)
    upgrade-npm             # Global npm packages (falls back to &#96;mise exec -- npm&#96; when npm not on PATH)
    upgrade-plugins         # LazyVim (:Lazy sync) + TPM + pre-commit autoupdate + tldr + gh extensions
    upgrade-uv              # uv self update + &#96;uv tool upgrade --all&#96; (Python CLI tools)

```

 Add new entries to &#96;.chezmoiexternal.toml.tmpl&#96; when the content is a plain clone / single file and the only conditional is &#96;.chezmoi.os&#96;. Keep things in Ansible when they need arch / &#96;noRoot&#96; / &#96;armv7l&#96; logic, dynamic version paths, or &#96;become: true&#96;. Full rationale + schema notes live in [docs/tools/chezmoi-prefixes.md → Companion file: &#96;.chezmoiexternal.&lt;format&gt;&#96;](docs/tools/chezmoi-prefixes.md#companion-file-chezmoiexternalformat).
 
+## Upgrades
+
+**Install vs upgrade is split on purpose.** &#96;chezmoi apply&#96; (+ the ansible phase it triggers) is deliberately install-only: roles use &#96;state: present&#96; / &#96;creates:&#96; so re-applying never silently bumps every tool on the machine. That keeps &#96;chezmoi apply&#96; boring, reproducible, and safe to run on a running box. The explicit upgrade path lives in [&#96;scripts/upgrade_tools.sh&#96;](scripts/upgrade_tools.sh), exposed via &#96;just upgrade-*&#96; recipes — it is the only thing that should move installed tools forward.
+
+**Entry points** (defined in [&#96;justfile&#96;](justfile)):
+
+| Recipe | Underlying action |
+|---|---|
+| &#96;just upgrade-all&#96; | Runs every category below in a canonical order. |
+| &#96;just upgrade-dry-run&#96; | Preview &#96;all&#96; without executing anything. |
+| &#96;just upgrade-brew&#96; | &#96;brew update&#96; + &#96;brew upgrade&#96; + &#96;brew upgrade --cask --greedy&#96; + &#96;brew bundle&#96; on &#96;~/.config/homebrew/Brewfile*&#96; **without** &#96;--no-upgrade&#96; + &#96;brew cleanup&#96;. macOS pre-warms the shared sudo session via [&#96;scripts/lib/sudo_shared.sh&#96;](scripts/lib/sudo_shared.sh) so cask pkg installers (&#96;sudo /usr/sbin/installer&#96;) find a live ticket. |
+| &#96;just upgrade-mise&#96; | &#96;mise self-update --yes&#96; + &#96;mise upgrade&#96; (runtimes pinned by &#96;~/.config/mise/config.toml&#96;). Self-update warns (not fails) when mise was installed via brew/apt. |
+| &#96;just upgrade-uv&#96; | &#96;uv self update&#96; + &#96;uv tool upgrade --all&#96; (covers every tool in [&#96;python_uv_tools/defaults/main.yml&#96;](dot_ansible/roles/python_uv_tools/defaults/main.yml) + [&#96;llm_tools&#96;](dot_ansible/roles/llm_tools/defaults/main.yml)). |
+| &#96;just upgrade-npm&#96; | &#96;npm -g update&#96;, falls back to &#96;mise exec -- npm -g update&#96; when npm is not on PATH (same detection as [&#96;js_cli_tools&#96;](dot_ansible/roles/js_cli_tools/tasks/main.yml) / [&#96;bitwarden&#96;](dot_ansible/roles/bitwarden/tasks/main.yml)). |
+| &#96;just upgrade-cargo&#96; | Bootstraps &#96;cargo-update&#96; crate if absent, then &#96;cargo install-update -a&#96;. Covers pueue (Linux) + any future entries in [&#96;cargo_tools&#96;](dot_ansible/roles/rust_cargo_tools/defaults/main.yml). |
+| &#96;just upgrade-dotnet&#96; | Parses tool names from [&#96;dotnet_tools/defaults/main.yml&#96;](dot_ansible/roles/dotnet_tools/defaults/main.yml) and runs &#96;dotnet tool update --global &lt;name&gt;&#96; per tool under the mise dotnet shim. Falls back to &#96;dotnet tool list --global&#96; if parsing finds nothing. |
+| &#96;just upgrade-gem&#96; | &#96;gem update --system&#96; + &#96;gem update&#96; via the mise ruby shim. |
+| &#96;just upgrade-agents&#96; | Re-runs the official &#96;curl \| bash&#96; installers for **only tools already present**: Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Ollama (Linux), llmfit (Linux), RTK. List mirrors [&#96;coding_agents&#96;](dot_ansible/roles/coding_agents/tasks/main.yml). |
+| &#96;just upgrade-plugins&#96; | &#96;nvim --headless "+Lazy! sync" +qa&#96; → &#96;~/.tmux/plugins/tpm/bin/update_plugins all&#96; → &#96;pre-commit autoupdate&#96; (in repo root) → &#96;tldr --update&#96; → &#96;gh extension upgrade --all&#96; (each guarded on the binary being present). |
+| &#96;just upgrade-externals&#96; | &#96;chezmoi upgrade&#96; (chezmoi binary itself) + &#96;chezmoi apply --refresh-externals&#96; (force-refresh the 168h externals: oh-my-zsh, TPM, toolkami.rb, fzf). |
+
+**Execution semantics.** The script is best-effort: a failure in one category does not abort later categories. At the end it prints one of:

All to-dos done and committed (`0458f8a`). Summary of what landed:

**New:** `scripts/upgrade_tools.sh` — best-effort runner, 10 categories (`externals`, `brew`, `mise`, `uv`, `npm`, `cargo`, `dotnet`, `gem`, `agents`, `plugins`), `--dry-run` / `--only` / `--skip` flags, sources `scripts/lib/sudo_shared.sh` for macOS cask-pkg sudo pre-warming, prints a `SUCCESS / SKIPPED / FAILED` summary, exits non-zero only when something actually failed.

**justfile:** new `# Upgrades` section with `just upgrade-all`, `upgrade-dry-run`, and one recipe per category.

**Docs:** full `## Upgrades` section in `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` (install-vs-upgrade rationale + category matrix + extension guide), and a "Keeping tools up-to-date" section in `README.md`. Toned down the misleading `mise ensures latest versions` phrasing — it only pins to `config.toml`; actual upgrades go through `just upgrade-mise`.

Tested via `./scripts/upgrade_tools.sh --dry-run all` — all 10 categories dispatch cleanly; `--only`/`--skip` work; `--help` works. Pre-commit (shellcheck + shfmt + gitleaks + redact-agent-secrets) all pass.

Side note on the commit hiccup: Homebrew's `pre-commit` was linked against a broken `python@3.14` (`pyexpat` missing symbol against system `libexpat`). Worked around per your suggestion by `uv tool install --force pre-commit --python 3.13` and prefixing `PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"` so the uv-managed pre-commit takes precedence. You may want to either put `~/.local/bin` ahead of `/opt/homebrew/bin` in your shell PATH or `brew uninstall pre-commit` so the uv-pinned one is the default going forward.
